name: Tesla Optimus
summary: Tesla’s bipedal humanoid in development; Tesla does not sell it, and sales to outside customers are a goal for 2027 at the earliest.

germany.statusNote: Not sold to anyone. Tesla’s AI page describes Optimus only as a development goal with job openings. netzwelt (22 Aug 2026) reports that sales to external customers could start in the second half of 2027 at the earliest; whether Optimus will be sold in Germany is open.

notes: Tesla publishes no specifications on its official page.

images.alt: Tesla Optimus humanoid in white and black, standing, three-quarter view

sources.title: Tesla will Optimus ab 2027 verkaufen (22 Aug 2026)
